baseline_preprocessing: Zero is the illustrative baseline; no normalization, filtering, or baseline correction is applied.
channel_order: Values are in the caller's declared index order 0 through 511; block 0 is indices 0–31, continuing in contiguous groups of 32.
missing_value_policy: A frame with a missing, non-numeric, NaN, or infinite channel is rejected; no imputation is performed.
permitted_use: Offline software and schema demonstration only; not operational monitoring, safety, medical, or control use.
scaling: Values are used as supplied; PilotTrace applies no additional scaling.
source_provenance: Deterministic local example data generated by tools/make_example.py.
timebase: Frame order is the only time axis; one frame is one synthetic step and no elapsed-time rate is asserted.
